name: Band Shoulder Pass-Through
steps: Stand with a wide overhand grip on the band in front of your thighs.
Sweep the band overhead and behind you within a comfortable shoulder range.
Reverse the arc to the front and continue moving smoothly.
tips: Widen your grip on the band if your elbows bend or your ribs flare upward.
Keep your arms straight and move slowly through any tight spots in your shoulders.
